text:
incident-bot: ALERT: p99 tail latency spike detected for /v1/stream/chunk (eu-west-2) — 18:03 UTC — SLO breach: p99 > 1200ms for 5m. Paging on-call. #incidents :rotating_light:

kate (on-call): seeing it, ack. grabbing dashboards now.

kevin (infra): joining. which traffic class? streaming or gen?

kate (on-call): streaming (long-poll websockets / chunking). p95 ~ 300ms, p99 ~ 1600ms. error-rate unchanged. no big deploys in last hour.

maria (sre): stacks show router ingress qdepth increasing on a subset of shards. looks like load concentrator with hot partitions in eu-west-2-a.

louise (prod-eng): I rolled the new routing policy to 10% in eu-west-2 at 17:48 — `prefer_local_fallback` that favors local capacity then falls back to same-az pools. could be related.

kevin (infra): can we confirm routing tables? dumping current route weights now.

ops-bot: ran /api/internal/routing/weights?region=eu-west-2 -> response: {"group_a": 0.0, "group_b": 0.9, "prefer_local_fallback": true} (truncated).

maria (sre): logs from router host rtr-euw2-12: repeated handoffs to same backend-ip for different session-ids, KV cache thundering, queueing on that host. looks like weight skew + sticky affinity bug.

kate (on-call): customer impact check — darren, can you confirm any support tickets?

darren (support): triage shows a handful of websocket reconnects from high-volume customers in EU; most retries succeeded. no increased 5xx. estimated affected sessions ~42k over last 20m, median reconnect <4s. sending proactive note to top 3 customers now.

kevin (infra): hypothesis: policy rollout set prefer_local_fallback=true but a separate flag that enforces sticky session assignment was accidentally enabled, causing many keys to land on a single warm node. that node's stream handler stalls when concurrent kv-cache misses spike.

louise (prod-eng): that matches the canary diff I saw: accidental `sticky_affinity: true` in the rollout manifest. I approved the rollout earlier today.

maria (sre): mitigation options: 1) flip routing policy back to previous behavior (disable prefer_local_fallback) 2) disable sticky_affinity globally 3) drain the hot backend 4) add temporary overflow routing to dedicated spare pool.

kate (on-call): prioritise quick mitigation with low blast radius. I want option 2 then 4. kevin, can you push an emergency config flip?

kevin (infra): doing it now. curl -X POST api.internal/config/update -d '{"routing.prefer_local_fallback":false, "routing.sticky_affinity":false}'

kevin (infra): response 202 accepted. patches being rolled out to edge-proxies in eu-west-2.

ops-bot: rollout status: 40% -> 70% -> 100% (eu-west-2).

maria (sre): observing p99 drop: 1600ms -> 950ms after first 20% of traffic flips. continuing to observe.

kate (on-call): start draining overloaded backend now to remove standing queue. kevin, which host?

maria (sre): host rtr-euw2-12 (10.12.5.12). drain initiated: `curl -X POST /admin/drain?rtr=10.12.5.12`

ops-bot: drain confirmed. traffic redistributed.

kevin (infra): opened emergency routing overflow: route-> spare-pool-eu (capacity 5k streams). added rule to catch keys with >3 concurrent sessions.

maria (sre): p99 now ~420ms, p95 stable. queue depth on rtr-euw2-12 cleared.

darren (support): sent customer advisory to 3 accounts with observed reconnects. included mitigation steps and ETA for RC.

louise (prod-eng): rolling back the 10% canary to ensure no further regressions; I'm initiating full rollback of the policy rollout.

kevin (infra): rollback complete. config matches pre-rollout state.

kate (on-call): good. I'll monitor for 30m and then decide whether to fully close page. maria, please capture traces and attach to postmortem. louise, create a revert PR and add a gating test to prevent sticky_affinity from shipping without explicit opt-in.

maria (sre): collecting flamegraphs + KV cache miss traces. saving timeline.

louise (prod-eng): will submit PR in next 60m. adding canary safeguard: require explicit opt-in flag.

kevin (infra): note: we observed cross-region fallback bouncing sessions to eu-west-1 for a subset — need to audit fallback mapping to avoid overloading neighbor regions.

kate (on-call): action items: Maria postmortem, Louise revert PR + gating test, Kevin audit fallback mappings, Darren customer notify summary. We keep page open until 30m no regressions.

darren (support): adding link to support ticket list: https://redwood.atlassian.net/servicedesk/STREAM-1234

maria (sre): initial impact summary for out-brief: ~42k sessions with transient reconnects (<4s), p99 spike to 1.6s for ~18 minutes, no 5xx inflation, no data loss, probable root cause: routing policy + sticky affinity bug created hot partitioning.

kate (on-call): thanks team. marking incident as "mitigated" for live traffic. keeping thread open for postmortem edits. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Incident update: severity lowered to SEV2, page remains open for review.

kevin (infra): quick note for follow-up: add more conservative default for `prefer_local_fallback` rollouts (start at 1%). and add preflight to diff for `sticky_affinity`.

louise (prod-eng): agreed. I'll include those in the revert PR.

maria (sre): I'll upload dashboards + raw traces to the incident repo: https://git.internal/redwood/incidents/1741239999

kate (on-call): handoff to maria for postmortem. I'm dropping out of page in 25m but available if needed.

darren (support): I'll compile customer-impact doc and send to gtm.

kevin (infra): thanks all. nice quick mitigation. :thumbsup:
